section.name: Conditional styles
section.p: DynamicJasper allows you to define a conditional style for a column. This means, when the expression of the conditional style returns true (in the report), the style defined in the conditional style will be applied to the column.
The example below uses the "amount" column of the FastReportTest report and makes it bold when the value is > 100.

section.name: Custom expression
section.p: Sometimes, the expression for a column is too complex or involves too much code to be written inline in the report. In this case, you can create a custom expression for the column.
The example below creates a report with one column and one group, and shows how to use a custom expression for the column (to get a formatted value for the group total).
The generated report is CustomExpressionReportTest.pdf and the code is in CustomExpressionReportTest.java.

section.name: AutoText
section.p: DynamicJasper allows you to add auto-text fields to the report. The auto-text fields are evaluated at runtime and their value is shown in the report.

section.name: Integración con Webwork
section.p: The example below shows how to integrate DynamicJasper with Apache Webwork (legacy). For Spring, Struts 2 o otros frameworks, use el JasperPrint generado por DynamicJasperHelper.generateJasperPrint() y exportarlo directamente con JRExporter a la respuesta HTTP.
